title: Ancient Ruins
next_chapter_hook: A hoarse yet familiar long laughter echoed from the depths of the ruins: 'Descendant, you've finally arrived.' That voice seemed to traverse countless ages, carrying boundless anticipation and bitterness...

text.content: At the entrance to the inner layer of the secret realm, a dilapidated palace sealed for ten thousand years loomed faintly through the mist. Chen Ji stared at that hazy silhouette, and the Tianji Record Fragment at his chest actually grew faintly hot, as if responding to some ancient summons. He drew a deep breath, his fingertips brushing against the scroll in his arms, a complex emotion rising in his heart. What kind of person was the master from ten thousand years ago?

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stood beside Chen Ji, a trace of vigilance flickering in her beautiful eyes. The aura of these ruins was far too ancient, exceeding her comprehension. 'Chen Ji, are you certain you want to enter?' Her voice was suppressed low, yet it sounded exceptionally clear in the silent secret realm. 'The seal here... seems to target only you.'

text.content: Upon hearing Su Qingyao's words, the corner of Chen Ji's mouth slightly curved upward, but he didn't answer her question. He slowly walked toward the half-open stone door, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm began to emit a faint golden light. The light resonated with the patterns on the stone door, and the sealed formations shattered one after another, dissolving into scattered light spots that vanished into the void. He turned his head, his gaze deep and calm.

dialogue.content: 'Senior Sister Su, have you ever thought—' Chen Ji's voice was very soft, yet carried an indescribable sense of emotion, 'some roads, once set upon, leave no possibility of turning back.' Before the words even finished, he had already stepped into the unknown darkness beyond the stone door.

text.content: The interior of the palace was grander than imagined. The walls on all sides were covered with dense符文, emitting a ghostly blue glow. However, what truly drew Chen Ji's gaze was the shattered altar in the center of the great hall. Above the altar floated a cluster of hazy light and shadow, seemingly some kind of residual memory image.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao followed closely into the palace. Her cultivation was sufficient to perceive the terrifying level of these符文—existence that transcended her understanding. She couldn't help but inhale a breath of冷气, lowering her voice: 'Chen Ji, these符文... were left by at least a Tribulation Crossing expert, possibly even higher.'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond to Su Qingyao. His gaze was deeply attracted by the light and shadow above the altar. That cluster of light gradually condensed, transforming into a blurry human silhouette. The figure wore a plain white robe, with a gaunt face, yet between its brows carried an indelible worry. Its outline... bore a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Xuan in the painting from Chen Ji's memories.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's heart suddenly contracted, an indescribable emotion surging in his chest. He stared at that light and shadow, his voice slightly trembling: 'Are you...' The light seemed to sense his presence and slowly turned around. Those deep eyes contained the vicissitudes and helplessness of an entire galaxy.

text.content: The light gave a slight nod, and an aged yet gentle voice rang out in the spacious hall: 'Descendant, you've finally arrived.' The light's gaze fell upon the torn scroll at Chen Ji's chest, its eyes flickering with a complex expression interweaving relief and pain. 'To see you means the Tianji Record hasn't completely severed its inheritance.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions in his heart, his voice recovering its usual calm: 'Senior, what relation do you have with Chen Xuan?' Upon hearing this, the light displayed a bitter smile, that smile carrying boundless vicissitudes and release.

text.content: 'Chen Xuan... was my grandson.' The light's voice was very soft, yet it stirred layers of echoes in the silent palace. This answer was like a thunderclap, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. He stood frozen, momentarily unable to digest this shocking information. The light continued, its voice carrying deep guilt.

dialogue.content: 'My name is Chen Tianji, the first generation master of the Tianji Record.' The light spoke slowly, its gaze filled with recollection. 'Back then, I peered into Heavenly Secrets too frequently, provoking the 'Eyes of Heavenly Way,' and was cursed by them, my life nearing its end. With no alternative, I split my life's work into several portions, scattered across the mortal world...'

text.content: Hearing this, an indescribable sorrow welled up in Chen Ji's heart. So the incompleteness of the Tianji Record wasn't due to erosion by time, but was actively done by its original master. He forced himself to remain calm and asked: 'Senior, what exactly is the Eyes of Heavenly Way? Is there a method to deal with it... left for me?'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao listened nearby, her heart pounding with fear. The Eyes of Heavenly Way—this name she had never seen in sect records, but the mere words 'provoking Heavenly Way' were enough for her to understand what kind of dangers lay hidden behind it. She unconsciously gripped her sword tighter, her gaze scanning the surroundings vigilantly.

text.content: The light fell silent for a moment, then waved its hand. The depths of the hall's wall violently cracked open, revealing a deep, dark passage. At the passage's end, a massive stone tablet could be vaguely seen, covered in dense ancient characters. The light's voice sounded again, carrying a hint of relieved ease.

dialogue.content: 'At the passage's end lies my ultimate legacy—the 'Counter Fate Stele.' The light's figure began to grow more illusory, as if it would dissipate at any moment. 'The stele records the only method to counter the Eyes of Heavenly Way. But descendant, I must warn you...' The light's gaze became incomparably solemn.

text.content: 'Although the Counter Fate Stele can break the Eyes of Heavenly Way's control, it requires paying an enormous price.' The light's voice turned low and serious. 'Each use consumes one-tenth of the inheritor's Heavenly Fate Value. If Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero...' The light didn't finish, but the unsaid implications made everyone's heart chill.

choice.prompt: Facing the ultimate legacy left by Chen Tianji, Chen Ji needed to make a choice—whether to immediately go view the complete content of the Counter Fate Stele, or first learn more about the secrets of the Eyes of Heavenly Way and the Tianji Record.

choices.text: Immediately go view the Counter Fate Stele
choices.description: Time is pressing; the threat of the Eyes of Heavenly Way grows closer each day, and we must quickly master a method to counter it.
choices.visible_cost: May consume exploration time and miss important information
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the key method to counter the Eyes of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: May overlook important warnings about side effects

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate in the slightest, turning to walk toward the passage's depths. He knew that every moment of delay increased the danger. Behind him, Su Qingyao was slightly stunned, then quickly followed. Her gaze fell on Chen Ji's straight back, an indescribable sourness rising in her heart—this man, how much burden does he carry that she doesn't know about?

choices.text: Inquire about the secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Before making a decision, one must clarify the complete truth of the Tianji Record, including why it chose oneself.
choices.visible_reward: Understand the complete origin of the Tianji Record and the reason for selecting its inheritor
choices.risk_hint: The light may dissipate at any moment

dialogue.content: When Su Qingyao heard Chen Ji's question, a flicker of approval appeared in her eyes. This man truly wasn't the reckless type. She unconsciously moved a step closer to Chen Ji, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, her gaze firmly fixed on that gradually dissipating light.

choices.text: Inquire about clues regarding sister Chen Nian
choices.description: Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key; her whereabouts relate to the success or failure of the entire scheme.
choices.visible_cost: May consume what little strength the light has left
choices.visible_reward: Obtain precious clues about Chen Nian's whereabouts
choices.risk_hint: The light may dissipate due to exhaustion of power

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao saw the flash of vulnerability in Chen Ji's eyes, her heart jolting. It was the first time she saw such an expression on this man—the deep concern of an older brother for his sister. She silently stepped forward, gently gripping Chen Ji's sleeve with a silent action to tell him: whatever happens, she would be by his side.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. The light's warning made him think of Chen Nian—that sister taken away by the Holy Sect, used as a Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Her ability to interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight made everything more complex. He raised his head, his eyes flashing with determination.

dialogue.content: 'Senior, I want to know—' Chen Ji's voice tightened slightly, 'what is the standard for the Tianji Record to choose an inheritor? Why me?' This question had troubled him for some time; he needed an answer.

text.content: Upon hearing this, the light displayed a meaningful smile. It slowly raised its hand, pointing at Chen Ji's chest—where the Tianji Record Fragment radiated a faint glow. 'The Tianji Record didn't choose you; it chose the bloodline within you.' The light's voice carried a sense of emotion.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Xuan was my grandson; his descendants inherited the bloodline compatible with the Tianji Record.' The light's gaze turned deep and distant. 'For ten thousand years, I've been waiting for a descendant qualified to inherit the Tianji Record. You... are the only one who has activated all the abilities of the Fragment.'

text.content: Chen Ji stood frozen, countless thoughts churning in his mind. So his bloodline connection to Chen Xuan was the true reason the Tianji Record chose him. He had always believed he relied on scheming and effort to reach where he was today, never realizing that from the very beginning, his fate was determined by bloodline.

dialogue.content: Hearing this, a complex emotion rose in Su Qingyao's heart. She had always thought Chen Ji was just a trash who survived by luck and intrigue, never expecting him to carry such a heavy bloodline destiny. Her gaze fell on Chen Ji's slightly rigid back, her chest inexplicably feeling stuffy.

text.content: 'Descendant, there's no need to be troubled by this.' The light seemed to see through Chen Ji's thoughts; the aged voice carried a gentle comfort. 'Bloodline is merely the threshold; what truly determines how far you can go has always been your own choices. The Tianji Record chose you because you are intelligent enough and patient enough—those are the most important things.'

choice.prompt: The light is about to dissipate. In the final moments, what does Chen Ji want to say to him?

choices.description: Pledge to the senior to complete his unfinished cause and counter the Eyes of Heavenly Way.
choices.visible_reward: Receive the light's final blessing and inheritance reinforcement
choices.risk_hint: Once a vow is made, it cannot be violated

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao gazed at Chen Ji's straight spine, her eyes slightly reddening. For the first time, she felt that this man who always hid in the shadows scheming actually harbored such a blazing fire in his heart. Her hand unconsciously tightened on the sword hilt, an unprecedented thought rising in her heart: to protect him.

choices.description: Better to practically understand the weaknesses of the Eyes of Heavenly Way than to make empty vows.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence about the weaknesses of the Eyes of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: May miss the light's final teachings

dialogue.content: When Su Qingyao heard Chen Ji's words, her brow slightly furrowed. This man... was indeed still that calculating Chen Ji. But she had to admit, this was his style—pragmatic, efficient, never wasting any time. She silently sighed, her gaze growing even more determined as it fell upon him.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, pressing all churning emotions deep into his heart. He raised his head, his gaze直视 that gradually dissipating light, his voice steady and powerful: 'Senior, rest assured. Since I have inherited the Tianji Record, I shall inherit your legacy. The Eyes of Heavenly Way... I will surely break it.'

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, the light's face bloomed with a relieved smile. Its figure had already faded to near transparency, yet the light in its eyes was brighter than ever. 'Good... good...' It said two 'good' words consecutively, its voice full of release and anticipation. 'Descendant, I have one final thing to tell you...'

text.content: The light's voice grew weaker and weaker, as if it would dissipate in the wind at any moment. Using its final strength, it spoke the words that made Chen Ji's entire body震: 'The core of the Counter Fate Stele... requires the Heavenly Fate Lock Key to activate. And Chen Nian in your words... she is the key.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted, a complex emotion surging in his heart. His sister Chen Nian was actually the key to activating the Counter Fate Stele? His fists unconsciously clenched, nails deeply embedding into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers. Seeing him like this, Su Qingyao's heart ached, and she unconsciously gripped his hand.

text.content: The light's figure finally dissipated completely, turning into scattered starlight drifting through the void. The hall returned to dead silence, only those ancient符文 still emitting their ghostly blue glow, as if recounting tales from ten thousand years ago. Chen Ji stood there, speechless for a long while.

Su Qingyao stood quietly beside him, saying nothing, only holding his hand tighter. She could feel the trembling in his fingertips—that was an emotion repressed to the extreme. This seemingly cold and ruthless man, after learning his sister's true purpose, what kind of torment was he enduring?

choice.prompt: Facing the final information left by the light, Chen Ji needs to make a choice—whether to immediately go to the Counter Fate Stele or first stabilize his state of mind.

choices.text: Immediately go to the Counter Fate Stele
choices.description: Time is pressing; we must quickly understand the complete method to activate the Counter Fate Stele.
choices.visible_cost: May miss important details due to emotional fluctuation
choices.visible_reward: Obtain information about the Counter Fate Stele at the first moment
choices.risk_hint: An unsettled mind may lead to misjudgments

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, pressing all emotions into the deepest part of his heart. His gaze turned calm and sharp once more—that was the disguise belonging to 'Trash Chen,' also his armor for navigating the world. He released Su Qingyao's hand and strode toward the passage's depths. Each step was steady and powerful, as if the earlier moment of wavering never happened.

choices.description: Before making any decision, one must calmly analyze the current situation.
choices.risk_hint: The Counter Fate Stele may have a time limit

dialogue.content: Seeing Chen Ji stop his steps, Su Qingyao's heart slightly relaxed. This man after all wasn't blinded by emotion. She stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, and softly said: 'Whatever decision you make, I will accompany you.' Her voice was soft, yet carried undeniable determination.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long while before finally turning to look at Su Qingyao. Those eyes, always cold, now revealed a rare vulnerability. 'Senior Sister Su...' His voice was somewhat hoarse. 'If one day, I must use Chen Nian to activate the Counter Fate Stele... what would you think of me?'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was怔住了. She had never expected that this always-calculating man would ask her such a question. Her heart suddenly tightened, an indescribable sourness welling up. She stepped forward, cupping Chen Ji's face with both hands, forcing him to meet her gaze.

'Chen Ji, you listen to me.' Su Qingyao's voice was unprecedentedly serious, her beautiful eyes shimmering with crystal-clear brilliance. 'You are not alone. No matter what lies ahead, I will not let you bear it alone.' Her fingertips gently brushed his cheek, taking away that trace of unnoticeable dampness.

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned. He looked at this beautiful face so close at hand, and something in his heart that had always been tightly wound slightly loosened. He opened his mouth, wanting to say something, yet found his throat blocked by something. This man who always calmly calculated everything couldn't say a single word at this moment.

dialogue.content: '...Thank you.' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice soft, yet carrying unprecedented sincerity. He didn't say more, but Su Qingyao understood everything from his gaze. This man who always hid himself in the shadows was finally willing to show a glimpse of his true self before her.

text.content: Just then, a low rumbling sound came from the depths of the passage. Following this, an aged yet familiar long laughter echoed from the depths of the ruins, reverberating through the spacious palace. That laughter carried boundless vicissitudes and anticipation, as if it had traversed countless ages, finally waiting for this moment.

'Descendant, you've finally arrived.' That voice was like thunder, exploding by Chen Ji and Su Qingyao's ears. Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted—this voice... though more aged and profound than Chen Tianji's light, he inexplicably felt a sense of familiarity. His heart rate suddenly accelerated; some intuition told him—the master of this voice was intricately connected to the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's hand was already on her sword hilt, her cultivation operating to the extreme, vigilantly watching the depths of the passage. However, Chen Ji stopped her with a raised hand. His gaze was deep and complex, staring into that dark depths, and slowly spoke: 'Who are you?'

That aged voice sounded again, carrying a playful smile: 'Who am I? Didn't the first page of the Tianji Record in your arms already tell you?' Chen Ji's entire body shuddered, unconsciously reaching toward the fragment at his chest. On the fragment, that line of ancient characters slowly revealed a name—Mo Xiansheng.
